formal_budget.interpretation: single-GPU wall-clock occupancy including data/serialization overhead, not measured SM-active time
formal_budget.sensitivity_formula: 1.25 * (1123080 * max rate excluding only the first CUDA training epoch + 56154 * max memory rate + 198 * max checkpoint write seconds + 6 * measured cold-start excess)
formal_budget.cold_start_note: Even amortizing the first-use excess once per trajectory leaves the upper estimate above 24 hours; no smaller model/batch/epoch/seed substituted.
formal_budget.minimum_pending_decision: Increase formal budget from 24 to 48 GPU hours, or defer; all method/data/GPU/seed/epoch settings stay fixed.

notes: P1 total wall time includes the serial remote decode audit; it is an upper bound on GPU occupancy. Later checkpoint-format checks used zero training steps. Exact follow-up wall time is recorded separately.
